claim_43.claim: ELISA kits analysis of supernatants from human dendritic cells stimulated in vitro with MPSV4 showed secretion of IL-6, TNF and IL-12p40 compared to unstimulated cells, whereas MCV4 induced less cytokine secretion.

sources.section: Results - Distinctive transcriptional programs in vaccine antibody responses
sources.quote: Up-regulation of co-stimulatory molecules and secretion of IL-6, TNF and IL-12p40 was detected in human DCs stimulated by MPSV4 (Fig. 6a).

comparison.finding: MPSV4-stimulated human dendritic cells secreted IL-6, TNF and IL-12p40 compared to unstimulated cells
MCV4 induced less IL-6, TNF and IL-12p40 secretion than MPSV4
